short: The signed-in area behind the session gate
is: The signed-in area — a group layout that bounces anonymous visitors to `/login` and wraps every page in the Explorer frame (the My Den tree beside the pane), containing My Den (`den/`), the account screens and the logout action; its errors render inside the frame.
conventions: The sign-in gate is the server `handle` hook (`lib/server/session-gate.ts`): no `(session)` load, data request (whatever loads it asks to skip) or form action runs without a session — except the sign-out route's default action (a POST that isn't a data request and names no other action), which reads nothing and must clear the browser's session even when the backend is down. The group layout's redirect only narrows the type (a backstop should anything else on the sign-out route ever render). A backend that doesn't answer gets the gate's own "isn't answering" page (503), never the sign-in page. The backend still checks the session on every call.
New signed-in routes JOIN this group rather than re-implementing the check.
Detail pages derive from the caller's own listing — there is no fetch-by-id rpc in v1; destructive actions require typed confirmation (WCAG 3.3.4).
Each page's load returns `trail` (App.PageData) for the frame's path bar; the frame itself reads nothing from the backend.
The sidebar, the drawer and every way into My Den show on every signed-in page, on every stack; there is no switch for a run without a Den.

fs.name: +error.svelte
fs.role: errors inside the frame, by status and route alone (ErrorView) — a failed sign-out says so; the error's message is never read

fs.name: +layout.server.ts
fs.role: hands the frame the session (the hook already refused anyone without one; the redirect here only narrows the type); and the web's own build id (buildId, "unknown" when ZURFUR_BUILD_ID is unset)

fs.name: +layout.svelte
fs.role: the Explorer frame (AppShell) around every signed-in page: the path from the page's `trail`; the My Den tree and the View options in the sidebar, fed by the frame's tree memory (never stored; started over on a flag flip, and on a form action's success, which the page that ran it reports, keeping `~` open); after each navigation the drawer closes and any open folder the tree lacks is fetched, at most four at a time through the frame's own queue (tree-loader's FetchQueue); the frame's bug report (provided as context, started over when the session's DID changes) and its dialog, ReportBugDialog

fs.name: accounts/
fs.role: listing + create action; [id]/ detail with typed-handle delete confirmation; the create superform applies an error result (onError: 'apply'), so the gate's 503 answer to its enhanced post shows the frame's error view (gate-answer.svelte.spec.ts); the delete form is enhanced (kit's enhance, applyAction in place), so a failed delete shows its problem without the page's reads running again and a completed one starts the tree over (delete-enhance.svelte.spec.ts)

fs.name: den/
fs.role: My Den: `[...path]` serves /den and every Den path below it, on every stack; request.spec.ts walks a signed-in and an anonymous `/den` through the real handle hook over the live port, and a page whose sixteen folder reads hang ending at the 15 s request deadline, counted from the request's start (the gate's /me included), through kit's real event.fetch. +page.server.ts is the only code that reads the Den (through lib/server/den.ts); +page.svelte is the right pane (DenPane) with in-place More (focus to the first new row), a one-place busy delay, heading focus, a generic title and a live region naming the opened item

fs.name: error.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: proves the in-frame error page never shows the error's message, that a failed sign-out says so, that a 503 says Zurfur isn't answering, and that its way back is My Den ($app/state mocked)

fs.name: layout.server.spec.ts
fs.role: spec for the gate — anonymous redirects, signed-in passes the session through; the build id, "unknown" when unset or unfit

fs.name: layout.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: the frame around a signed-in page with real styles ($app/state and afterNavigate mocked): banner + main + path, Accounts current, Sign out in the top bar, skip link first, drawer closes on navigation, one Accounts and a visible Sign out in the drawer, no sideways scroll at 320 px; the tree memory built for the session's DID and told the current DID on each navigation; missing folders fetched after a navigation to a page with no Den data; sixteen folders above a deep item fetched at most four at a time; "Report a bug" opens the dialog over the page, reporting it; the draft kept for the visitor and started over for another

fs.name: logout/
fs.role: an action, not a page — a stray GET goes home; the action always clears zurfur.sid, mirrors the backend's clears when it confirms, and otherwise lands on /login?signout=unconfirmed

fs.name: report-a-bug/
fs.role: the report page: +page.server.ts — the load offers the page from a Referer exactly on the first party (its path, the archived words, its page type) or asks "Which page?", and the browser from the User-Agent, cut; the one action reads the post through the bug-report schema and answers fail(400) naming the refused item, fail(429) for the limit, fail(502) for could not send, or { kind: 'sent', reference }, redirecting an ended session to /login; +page.svelte — the shared ReportBugForm over the load's offer ("Which page?" when it asks, and after a refusal answered without script), posting BUG_REPORT_FIELDS with plain enhance, working without script (page.svelte.spec.ts); request.spec.ts proves the root hook refuses a cross-origin post before the action runs
